name: Is AI property valuation free, or does it cost money?

mainEntity.name: Is AI property valuation free, or does it cost money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many initial AI property valuations offered online are free, providing homeowners with a quick, general estimate of their property's value. These free tools are excellent for getting a preliminary idea of market worth. For more detailed or frequent AI-powered insights, especially those integrated into professional real estate services, there might be associated costs or it could be part of a broader service package. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution often provides these as part of client services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AI property valuations are often free for a general estimate, but more detailed services may have associated costs.
